method: Curated five new English small-model families, balancing HF monthly downloads and likes; not a global objective top-five ranking. Search top 100 text-to-speech repos sorted by downloads and likes plus supplemental named-family checks. Tiny/small bound: no more than 100M required neural synthesis parameters including decoder; public weights, English, one case per family, exclude existing benchmark models. Download counts are repository-level activity, not unique users or quality scores.

selected.reason: Very high download adoption and likes; established official JavaScript runtime.
High-download 15M English checkpoint; FP32 for common CPU/GPU configuration.
High-download sub-3M family and official browser WASM runtime; Amy selected as English checkpoint.
454 likes for a complete 9.36M English stack with official ONNX export.
Established 36M English model with substantial downloads and official Transformers.js support.

exclusions.reason: Exact tiny weights gated; no verified browser runtime for these new architectures. Older 100M community ports do not establish tiny-checkpoint support.
130,907,520 backbone parameters before codec exceed the selected complete-stack 100M bound.
100M language model plus required ~22M audio tokenizer exceeds complete-stack bound.
Requires BERT-base-uncased frontend in addition to synthesis model; complete neural stack exceeds bound.
80M backbone plus separate 121MB decoder; lower monthly downloads than selected established families. Deferred, not judged inferior.
User requested additional models; no duplicate cases.
